description: M5 Verification & conflict resolution / Verify (tasks.md T5.1-T5.6, FR-16-FR-21, E-4, E-5, E-8, E-11, AC-5, AC-6, AC-9, AC-12). Add per-field cross-check with provenance, an authority-precedence conflict resolver that preserves losing values as Conflict rows, official-page verification that degrades gracefully on parse failure, event-level verification_state + derived confidence incl. food-disagreement, and cancellation detection with a history entry. Depends on FEAT-004 (merged events) and config.authority_precedence.
steps: Create vandy_food_radar/verify/__init__.py and vandy_food_radar/verify/conflict.py: for each canonical field of a merged event, gather each contributing source's value; emit a FieldProvenance with agreement agreed/resolved_conflict/single_source/missing. On disagreement, choose by config.authority_precedence (official_page > anchor_link > google_calendar), tie-break by most recent source_updated_at (fallback checked_at, noting the fallback), and record a Conflict with ALL competing values (losers preserved) plus the resolution rule applied. Pure given the records.

Create vandy_food_radar/verify/verifier.py: apply resolved values to the canonical Event; incorporate the official-page record with top authority; a parse_error/fetch_error official record is removed from comparison (graceful degrade, no crash). Derive verification_state (verified | partially_verified | conflicting | food_unconfirmed | cancelled) and a deterministic confidence in [0,1] from fraction of fields agreed + presence of top-authority source + food-confirmation status + RSVP link health. Handle food disagreement (E-5: food claimed on one source, absent/contradicted on another -> food_unconfirmed/conflicting, reduce confidence). Detect cancellation from any authoritative record (parsed_fields cancelled / '[CANCELLED]' / status) -> cancelled state (overrides others) and append an EventHistory entry. Set rsvp_link_ok from the official-page fetch result (broken -> False, E-8).

Create tests/test_verify.py: career-mixer resolves to official-page 18:00 with 18:30 preserved as a Conflict and state conflicting (AC-5); recency tie-break selects the most recently updated when authority ties; food disagreement reduces confidence / sets food_unconfirmed (AC-6); cancelled event -> cancelled + history entry (AC-12); unparseable official page degrades gracefully, event still produced, gap reflected (AC-9, E-11); broken RSVP link flagged (E-8).
acceptance_criteria: Per-field agreement detection produces FieldProvenance for every canonical field (T5.1, FR-16/17).
Conflicts resolve by authority precedence with recency tie-break and preserve all losing values as Conflict rows (T5.2, FR-18/19, AC-5).
Official-page verification uses top authority and degrades gracefully on parse/fetch failure without crashing (T5.3, FR-3/7, AC-9).
verification_state and derived confidence are set; food disagreement handled (T5.4, FR-20/21, E-5, AC-6).
Cancellation yields cancelled state + a history entry (T5.5, E-4, AC-12).
uv run pytest tests/test_verify.py passes and `make check` is green.
findings:
Implemented in vandy_food_radar/verify/ (conflict.py, verifier.py, __init__.py). Pure/deterministic, no I/O. Import surface: `from vandy_food_radar.verify import verify, VerifiedEvent, resolve_field, SourceValue, FieldResolution, CROSS_CHECKED_FIELDS`.

ENTRY POINT: verify(merged: MergedEvent, source_records: Mapping[str, SourceRecord], *, config: Config) -> VerifiedEvent. source_records is keyed by SourceRecord.id (== NormalizedRecord.source_record_id); it supplies source_updated_at/checked_at/parse_status which NormalizedRecord does NOT carry. Ranking/web should build this map from the same SourceRecords fed to normalize.

VerifiedEvent dataclass: {event: Event (canonical, resolved values applied), provenance: list[FieldProvenance], conflicts: list[Conflict] (losers preserved), history: list[EventHistory]}.

CROSS-CHECKED FIELDS (conflict.CROSS_CHECKED_FIELDS, stable order): title, event_date, start_time, end_time, location, organizer, rsvp_required, rsvp_url, event_url, food_confirmed, food_category, food_description. resolve_field emits one FieldProvenance per field with agreement in {agreed, resolved_conflict, single_source, missing}. Present = not None and not blank-string. Equality compare normalizes strings (lower + collapse whitespace); other types compare as-is. food_confirmed/food_category are compared/stored by their StrEnum .value.

CONFLICT RESOLUTION (winner select, deterministic sort key): (authority_rank asc via config.authority_precedence.index; unknown source sorts last), then recency DESC (source_updated_at, fallback checked_at; missing => oldest), then source_id.value. On disagreement a Conflict row is created with ALL competing values (CompetingValue{value, source_id, source_updated_at}) and resolution note 'authority_precedence -> <source>' (+ ' (recency tie-break used checked_at fallback)' when the winner had no source_updated_at). VERIFIED: career-mixer resolves start_time to official_page 18:00, google_calendar 18:30 preserved as loser, state conflicting (AC-5). Equal-authority tie -> most recently updated wins.

GRACEFUL DEGRADE: any member whose NormalizedRecord.parse_status OR its SourceRecord.parse_status != OK is dropped from field comparison (comparable list). Unparseable official page => contributes no values, event still built from remaining sources, no crash (E-11, AC-9).

EVENT-LEVEL FOOD (_resolve_food over comparable members, E-5/AC-6): {confirmed}->confirmed; {confirmed,contradicted}->contradicted + conflicting=True; {contradicted,...}->contradicted; {confirmed,unconfirmed}->UNCONFIRMED (confirmed on one, unmentioned on other = not fully verified); all-unconfirmed/empty->unconfirmed. event.food_confirmed is set from this (NOT from the per-field resolver; _apply_field skips food_confirmed). food_category IS applied from the resolver.

RSVP HEALTH (rsvp_link_ok, tri-state, E-8): checks ALL merged.members (incl. dropped): None if no member has an rsvp_url; False if a member advertising an rsvp_url has a source whose parse_status != OK (broken); else True.

VERIFICATION_STATE derivation (cancelled overrides everything else): cancelled if ANY member.cancelled (E-4) -> state cancelled + one EventHistory{field_name='verification_state', new_value='cancelled', changed_at=now UTC, reason=...}. Otherwise, order: food_conflicting OR key-field conflict (KEY_FIELDS = {event_date, start_time, location}) -> conflicting; else food not CONFIRMED -> food_unconfirmed; else any conflict -> conflicting; else any single_source/missing field -> partially_verified; else verified.

CONFIDENCE FORMULA (deterministic, [0,1], round 4dp): 0.5*(agreed_fields/12) + 0.2*(top_authority_present?1:0) + 0.2*food_score + 0.1*rsvp_score, where food_score {confirmed:1.0, unconfirmed:0.4, contradicted:0.0}; rsvp_score {None(no link):1.0 neutral, True:1.0, False:0.0}; top_authority = config.authority_precedence[0] (official_page) present among comparable members. Food-on-one-source-only lowers confidence vs both-confirmed.

Event shell from dedup is cloned (not mutated); resolved value of None leaves the shell value in place. tests/test_verify.py (8 tests) green; full make check green (79 tests, ruff+black+mypy --strict clean).
